Income Tax Act, 1961 : Section 10(4-A). Income Tax-Exemption from-Non- resident (External) Account-Inter­ est earned on-AYs I983-84 and 1984-85-Assessee, a foreign citizen, stayed in India for a short period during the AYs with his wife-Assessee claimed exemption under S. JO( 4-A) in re~pect Stay contemplated under S.2(p)(iii)(c) of the FERA has to be of some permanence and not a mere casual stay or stay for a short period-Hence, assessee is not a person resident in India-There.fore, he is entitled to exemption. Foreign Exchange Regulation Act, 1973 : Section 2(q)--Person resident
